problem: Close the release-candidate boundary for the selected Poki distribution path while preserving a platform-neutral direct-web owner target, privacy-safe optional telemetry, exact-head evidence and a certified scoped visual direction.

decision.rationale: The release candidate keeps portal APIs behind adapters, starts and stops gameplay at the selected portal lifecycle boundaries, defaults optional telemetry to denied, publishes a privacy policy and licenses the pinned Poki SDK, and certifies the current code-native art direction against measurable V-001 constraints. Direct web remains the deterministic owned target and CrazyGames remains a safe fallback adapter.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Adds candidate-side release checks, privacy/telemetry contracts and portal metadata but does not change the trusted validator, required status checks, permissions or ruleset authority. The candidate release checker is a producer check; trusted validate-pr-evidence remains authoritative for evidence policy.
governance.bypass_analysis: The release checker rejects non-SHA heads, missing/oversized/empty bundles, missing wasm, failed browser smoke, startup over budget and any exposed debug bridge. The manifest remains exact-head bound through the trusted validator; no candidate workflow can self-approve its own governance policy.
governance.rollback: Revert the P8 release-candidate commits. Gameplay falls back to the direct-web adapter, save v4 remains unchanged, and the prior P7 content closeout remains the last accepted product state.

selected_references.name: A Short Hike / compact authored route
selected_references.selection_reason: It demonstrates a compact authored world where local landmarks carry orientation.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Readable places and traversal rhythm do the navigation work without a dense map layer.
selected_references.inference: The release candidate should preserve named authored regions, landmarks and one readable objective.

selected_references.name: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure / habitat readability
selected_references.selection_reason: It differentiates natural spaces through gentle objectives and local visual context.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Habitat identity is carried by silhouettes, color grouping and low-pressure tasks.
selected_references.inference: Distinct BeBee region palettes, flower identities and state cues can remain readable without adding combat or management.

anti_pattern.observation: A broad management game joins progression to several additional relationship, crafting and planning surfaces.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not expand the release candidate into a management layer; keep the core fantasy, one currency and existing save/progression loop.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Use gameplayStart on first input, gameplayStop on interruptions/completion and avoid duplicate lifecycle calls.
Pin the Defold Poki SDK extension and call its Lua lifecycle/measurement functions only through an adapter.
Keep the secondary portal implementation optional and platform-neutral.
Serve wasm with application/wasm, use an HTTP server and treat browser storage as asynchronous.
Platform lifecycle interruptions must stop gameplay timing cleanly.
Measure bundle size and retain a fixed release budget.

alternatives.reason: Matches P-001 while keeping gameplay independent of portal SDK availability and preserving owned direct-web QA.
Violates P-002/T-005 and makes local/test targets depend on external SDK globals.
Conflicts with deny-by-default privacy and adds an unnecessary backend dependency.
Would add licensing, loading and style-system risk; the scoped code-native visual certification is explicit and measurable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Poki lifecycle starts on first input, stops on interruption/completion, and duplicate calls are idempotent.
Direct web remains safe without an installed SDK; CrazyGames is an optional safe fallback.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: portal service/adapters and deterministic adapter tests

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Optional telemetry is denied by default, contains no PII and has an explicit consent contract.
Release bundle has a pinned/licensed portal dependency, privacy policy and no unsafe development bridges.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: game.project, config/dependencies.json, THIRD_PARTY.md, release/privacy-policy.html, release checker and release negative smoke

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Release bundle/startup remain within the fixed candidate budgets.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: release checker, release QA config, exact-head HTML5 build report and browser startup measurement

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The current code-native illustrative visual direction is explicitly certified for this scoped release candidate.

manual: desktop and mobile release-candidate capture matrix
verification.runtime_errors: exact-head Chromium journeys require console=0, page=0, network failures=0 and external requests=0; release negative check requires every known development bridge absent.
verification.save_data_impact: No save schema bump. Save v4 and existing migration/recovery matrix remain authoritative; portal lifecycle and optional telemetry are transient adapters only.

motion_evidence: Exact-head Chromium movement journey records real keyboard traversal, pollination sweeps, modal pause/resume, region completion and reload.
Capture manifest contains desktop/mobile stills plus motion-report.json and zero-error diagnostics.

provenance.artifact_locator: GitHub Actions HTML5 CI retained artifacts named with the exact PR head

measurements.qa_bridges: all known development bridges absent from release
measurements.telemetry_default: denied until explicit consent and release config
measurements.art_scale: bee 12-15% of 720px reference viewport; persistent HUD clusters <= 2

objective_clarity.note: The existing objective and world-space progress cues remain readable in retained desktop/mobile captures.

state_readability.note: Region palettes, named landmarks and non-color state cues provide a coherent scoped visual language.

feedback_quality.note: Movement, pollination, reward, lifecycle and reload feedback are coherent; final market-scale art quality is outside this scoped certification.

findings: No functional ITERATE finding is open. The release boundary, portal lifecycle, privacy defaults, bundle/startup budgets and scoped visual certification pass exact-head evidence.
Accepted scope note: external portal upload/player-fit and production ad configuration are launch operations after this repository release candidate; they are not hidden in-repo runtime dependencies.

known_limitations: Poki Inspector upload, external portal player-fit and ad configuration remain a launch-operation gate, not an in-repository runtime dependency.
No account, cloud save or BeBee-owned remote analytics service is introduced; local save v4 remains the product data model.
